notes.1702: OSM tags this building "Leased Out" and names it only by number; not a class building.

notes.manzanita-mohave: Midpoint of OSM's Manzanita Hall (way/34156275) and Mohave Hall (way/34156278), alias "Manzi-Mo" for both in UA Planning, Design & Construction's Residence Life Housing layer (services.maps.arizona.edu/pdc/rest/services/campus_features/MapServer/38).
notes.navajo-pinal-stadium: OSM names neither building; midpoint of Navajo Residence Hall (1557 E 6 St) and Pinal Residence Hall (1511 E 6 St) in UA Planning, Design & Construction's Residence Life Housing layer (services.maps.arizona.edu/pdc/rest/services/campus_features/MapServer/38).
notes.pueblo-de-la-cienega: Centre of OSM's Pueblo La Cienega (way/34124088); Pueblo De La Cienega, 621 N Highland Ave, in UA Planning, Design & Construction's Residence Life Housing layer (services.maps.arizona.edu/pdc/rest/services/campus_features/MapServer/38).
notes.villa-del-puente: Centre of OSM's Villa Puente (relation/2908362); Villa Del Puente, 575 N Highland Ave, in UA Planning, Design & Construction's Residence Life Housing layer (services.maps.arizona.edu/pdc/rest/services/campus_features/MapServer/38).
notes.graham: Graham Residence Hall, part of the Graham-Greenlee hall, not a class building.
notes.greenlee: Greenlee Residence Hall, part of the Graham-Greenlee hall, not a class building.
notes.pueblo-la-cienega: OSM's Pueblo La Cienega is the Pueblo de la Cienega residence hall, not a class building; its centre falls outside its U-shaped footprint, so the hall's pin doesn't claim it.
notes.central-heating-and-refrigeration-plant: A utility plant, not somewhere classes or meals happen.

detours.why: Hopi Lodge (way/34124123) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the service drive on its south side, so walks to the buildings north of it go out to Vine Avenue and back up.

Pima Hall (way/34228231) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the service drive on its south side, and the buildings west of it are across North Mountain Avenue, reached by the mapped crossing to the north.

The Manzanita-Mohave pin snaps to the service drive east to Olive Road, and Drama (way/34156379) has no mapped entrance and is reached by the footways on its north side, so the walk goes out to Olive Road and round.
Neither building has a mapped entrance in OSM, so each end joins the nearest mapped path from its centre, which here lies on the far side of the building; the walk goes round it (ratios 2.5 to 2.9).
